proof:
set -eu
printf 'container=%s\n' "$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpuset.cpus.effective)"
printf 'bandwidth=%s\n' "$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max)"
printf 'uid=%s\n' "$(id -u)"
printf 'go=%s\n' "$(go version)"
if command -v taskset >/dev/null; then
  for mask in 0 3 0-3; do
    taskset -c "$mask" sh -ec 'printf "request=%s inherited=" "$1"; awk "/^Cpus_allowed_list/ {print \$2}" /proc/self/status' sh "$mask"
  done
else
  echo 'taskset=absent'
fi
stdout:
container=0-3
bandwidth=100000 100000
uid=0
go=go version go1.26.11 linux/arm64
request=0 inherited=0
request=3 inherited=3
request=0-3 inherited=0-3
